characters.summary: Billy Sole is a calm, intuitive American tracker who relies on traditional blades, firearms, and tracking instincts. He makes a final stand against the Predator using a machete.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to superior extraterrestrial weaponry and physical strength
limitations: Limited to standard human physical endurance and conventional weaponry

sources.supports: Billy Sole's role as tracker and his final confrontation with the Predator.

feats.claim: Tracks the guerrilla forces through dense jungle terrain and senses the presence of the invisible Predator.
Stands his ground on a log bridge with a machete to fight the Predator in hand-to-hand combat.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and killed in close quarters after challenging the creature alone.

unknowns: Full extent of his tracking background outside of the film narrative

characters.summary: Bishop is an advanced synthetic crew member possessing superhuman calculation, physical resilience, and analytical capabilities, though he remains vulnerable to extreme physical damage.

mechanisms: Synthetic physiology lacking biological pain receptors

weaknesses: Vulnerable to structural tearing or heavy mechanical destruction
limitations: Cannot violate his programmed directives regarding human safety

sources.supports: Bishop's synthetic nature, skills, and interactions with the Alien Queen.

feats.claim: Performs rapid knife play between a crew member's fingers with extreme precision.
Remotely pilots a dropship into the hive area under hazardous conditions.

notableResults.note: Torn in half by the Queen while attempting to secure Newt.

campaignTags.claim: Artificial person engineered by the Weyland-Yutani Corporation
Pilots the dropship to rescue survivors

unknowns: Exact internal specifications of synthetic hardware across alternate continuities

characters.summary: Bryan Mills is a highly trained former CIA operative specializing in close-quarters combat, interrogation, firearms, and tactical tracking.
weaknesses: Subject to normal human vulnerabilities and injuries
limitations: Relies on human physical limits and available gear

sources.supports: Bryan Mills's background as a retired operative and his rescue operations.

feats.claim: Infiltrates criminal strongholds and neutralizes multiple armed opponents single-handedly.
Tracks down a human trafficking ring across Paris using minimal investigative leads.

notableResults.note: Interrogates and defeats kidnappers to track his daughter.

unknowns: Complete roster of all past covert operations before his retirement

characters.summary: Colonel Bagley is a seasoned American military officer who commands conventional troops with firearms and cavalry tactics, holding a cynical view of native warriors.
weaknesses: Overconfident against unconventional ambush tactics and melee charges
limitations: Dependent on conventional military hierarchy and equipment

sources.supports: Colonel Bagley's role as commander and combat actions in the film.

feats.claim: Directs Gatling gun and rifle units during infantry engagements against traditional forces.

notableResults.note: Defeated when conventional forces are overwhelmed by samurai charges.

unknowns: Combat history during the American Civil War prior to the expedition to Japan

weaknesses: Aged physical condition compared to active frontline combatants

limitations: Limited by standard human endurance and aging

characters.summary: Commodus is a Roman Emperor who utilizes imperial guards, political manipulation, and hidden dagger combat within controlled arena settings.
weaknesses: Prone to emotional instability, cowardice under pressure, and physical fatigue
limitations: Relies on political power and guards rather than elite martial prowess

sources.supports: Commodus's role as emperor and his final duel in the Colosseum.

feats.claim: Secretly wounds Maximus with a poisoned blade prior to their arena duel.

notableResults.note: Slain in the Colosseum by Maximus during single combat despite a hidden injury advantage.

unknowns: True extent of his formal gladiatorial training outside of imperial indulgence

characters.continuity: Conan the Barbarian (1982 film) and sequels
characters.summary: Conan is a towering Cimmerian warrior possessing immense physical strength, mastery of broadswords and battle axes, and fierce indomitable will.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to powerful sorcery and overwhelming numbers without prep
limitations: Relies entirely on physical weapons and muscle power without advanced technology or magic

sources.supports: Conan's feats of strength, combat training, and battles against Thulsa Doom's cult.

feats.claim: Pushes a massive heavy millstone for years as a slave, developing exceptional physical strength.
Decapitates multiple armed cultists in close melee combat during temple raids.

notableResults.note: Beheads Thulsa Doom with Atlantean sword after destroying his cult.

campaignTags.claim: Infiltrates the Tower of Serpents using climbing and stealth

unknowns: Exact limits of his resilience against supernatural curses

characters.summary: Deputy Art Galt is an aggressive law enforcement officer who employs standard firearms, vehicles, and a hostile patrol approach.
weaknesses: Reckless temperament and underestimation of skilled guerrilla fighters
limitations: Dependent on conventional police infrastructure and authority

sources.supports: Deputy Galt's confrontations with Rambo in the woods.

feats.claim: Hunts Rambo in the woods using a helicopter and hunting rifle.

notableResults.note: Killed when Rambo throws a rock at his helicopter, causing him to fall.

unknowns: Prior law enforcement record before the events in Hope, Washington

characters.summary: Dillon is a CIA operative and former military commando who uses assault rifles, sidearms, and tactical teamwork in jungle combat.
weaknesses: Overconfident in corporate and government leverage over survival situations
limitations: Limited to standard human physical capacity and tactical gear

sources.supports: Dillon's role as CIA liaison and his final armed stand against the Predator.

feats.claim: Engages guerrilla forces in a firefight and manages heavy weapons in jungle terrain.
Tracks and corners the Predator with Dutch using firearms.

notableResults.note: Arm severed and killed by the Predator after a brief firefight.

unknowns: Specific details of past covert missions prior to the rescue operation

characters.summary: Dutch Schaefer is an elite paramilitary rescue team leader who excels in improvised traps, guerrilla combat, firearms, and sheer tactical ingenuity against superhuman threats.

mechanisms: Mud coating to mask heat signature

weaknesses: Vulnerable to raw physical trauma and plasma blasts without environmental prep
limitations: Dependent on physical conditioning and improvised resources when outmatched technologically

sources.supports: Dutch's survival skills, combat feats, and final victory over the Predator.

feats.claim: Annihilates an armed guerrilla encampment with his elite squad using coordinated firepower and explosives.
Constructs complex pulley traps, tripwires, and counterweights to damage the Predator.

notableResults.note: Defeats the extraterrestrial hunter using an improvised counterweight trap after utilizing mud camouflage.

campaignTags.claim: Uses mud camouflage to conceal his thermal signature from the Predator
Constructs complex counter-traps and weighted log pitfalls from jungle materials

unknowns: Exact whereabouts and activities following his helicopter extraction
